name: IMUD@FluffOS.v2019
english_description: The FluffOS project's own tiny live demo at imud.fluffos.info, not a game: connecting drops you straight into an anonymous session (no login, no registration, no player object/save data, no rooms) with exactly two commands, mudlist (lists the real, live Intermud-3 network via a genuine outbound socket connection to the *i4 router) and update (reload an object by path). Included as a preserved reference example of a minimal from-scratch FluffOS mudlib/I3-client rather than a wuxia game.
